title: Keep a deterministic write in the sandbox temp dir observable (DEC-189 (5), #14 follow-up)
description: test-skills#14 round 3 follow-up. oracle.py drops the WHOLE .oracle-sandbox/tmp/ subtree from the file channel, so a mutant writing a DETERMINISTIC file there (e.g. gettempdir()/report.txt with different content) reads equivalent, while every verdict still says observed: workspace, home, tmp - which DEC-189 (5) names as observed. Fix: drop only the random names the tempfile module generates (its random-name pattern), and keep every other tmp write observable. Pin it by strengthening the existing stderr/tempfile case with a deterministic tmp write (both ways). Also fix the module docstring, which still says the snapshot walks the whole tree with nothing skipped - state the tmp-name exclusion and the DEC-189 (5) known-false-equivalent boundary. Count stays 79.
